sentences.text: Diego cambió la bombilla del pasillo, que llevaba semanas fundida.
sentences.en: Diego changed the light bulb in the hallway, which had been burnt out for weeks.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 몇 주째 나가 있던 복도 전구를 갈았어요.

sentences.text: En el jardín de Sofía colgaron una guirnalda de bombillas para la cena.
sentences.en: In Sofía's garden they hung a string of light bulbs for the dinner.
sentences.ko: 소피아네 정원에 저녁 모임을 위해 전구 줄을 걸었어요.

sentences.text: En el desván, Diego encontró una figurita de un peregrino con su bastón y su concha.
sentences.en: In the attic, Diego found a little figure of a pilgrim with his staff and shell.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 다락방에서 지팡이와 조개껍데기를 든 순례자 인형을 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Uno de los amigos de Sofía acaba de volver del Camino y todos lo llaman el peregrino.
sentences.en: One of Sofía's friends has just come back from the Camino and everyone calls him the pilgrim.
sentences.ko: 소피아의 친구 한 명이 순례길에서 막 돌아와서 다들 그를 순례자라고 불러요.

sentences.text: La vecina de Diego le trajo un bizcocho de limón para celebrar que por fin había terminado el tejado.
sentences.en: Diego's neighbour brought him a lemon sponge cake to celebrate finally finishing the roof.
sentences.ko: 이웃집 아주머니가 지붕 공사가 드디어 끝난 걸 축하하려고 디에고에게 레몬 카스텔라를 가져왔어요.

sentences.text: Sofía apareció en la cena con un bizcocho de chocolate hecho por ella.
sentences.en: Sofía showed up at the dinner with a chocolate sponge cake she had made herself.
sentences.ko: 소피아는 직접 만든 초콜릿 케이크를 들고 저녁 모임에 나타났어요.

sentences.text: Tras tres horas sin encontrar la fuga, Diego estaba frustrado y se sentó en la escalera.
sentences.en: After three hours without finding the leak, Diego was frustrated and sat down on the stairs.
sentences.ko: 세 시간 동안 새는 곳을 못 찾자 디에고는 답답해서 계단에 주저앉았어요.

sentences.text: Carlos estaba frustrado porque el tren se retrasó y llegó tarde a la reunión con Sofía.
sentences.en: Carlos was frustrated because the train was delayed and he arrived late to the get-together with Sofía.
sentences.ko: 카를로스는 기차가 늦어 소피아와의 모임에 늦게 도착해서 속상했어요.

sentences.text: Para subir la carretilla al porche, Diego construyó una rampa con tablones.
sentences.en: To get the wheelbarrow up to the porch, Diego built a ramp out of planks.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 손수레를 현관까지 올리려고 널빤지로 경사로를 만들었어요.

sentences.text: El restaurante tenía una rampa en la entrada, así que Lucía pudo entrar con la silla de ruedas sin problema.
sentences.en: The restaurant had a ramp at the entrance, so Lucía could get in with her wheelchair without any trouble.
sentences.ko: 식당 입구에 경사로가 있어서 루시아는 휠체어를 타고 문제없이 들어갈 수 있었어요.

sentences.text: En la cocina vieja, Diego halló un azulejo pintado con un pulpo azul.
sentences.en: In the old kitchen, Diego found a tile painted with a blue octopus.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 옛 부엌에서 파란 문어가 그려진 타일을 발견했어요.

sentences.text: Sofía pidió pulpo a la gallega para compartir con todo el grupo.
sentences.en: Sofía ordered Galician-style octopus to share with the whole group.
sentences.ko: 소피아는 다 같이 나눠 먹으려고 갈리시아식 문어 요리를 시켰어요.

sentences.text: La abuela de Diego guardaba la manteca en un tarro de barro en la despensa.
sentences.en: Diego's grandmother kept the lard in a clay jar in the pantry.
sentences.ko: 디에고의 할머니는 라드를 식료품 창고의 흙 항아리에 보관했어요.

sentences.text: En el pueblo de Sofía, las magdalenas se hacen con manteca y quedan muy tiernas.
sentences.en: In Sofía's village, muffins are made with lard and turn out very soft.
sentences.ko: 소피아네 마을에서는 머핀을 라드로 만들어서 아주 부드러워요.

sentences.text: La abuela de Diego guardaba la manteca en un tarro de barro en la despensa.
sentences.en: Diego's grandmother kept the lard in a clay jar in the pantry.
sentences.ko: 디에고의 할머니는 라드를 식료품 창고의 흙 항아리에 보관했어요.

sentences.text: La despensa de Sofía se quedó vacía después de tantos invitados.
sentences.en: Sofía's pantry was left empty after so many guests.
sentences.ko: 손님이 그렇게 많이 오고 나니 소피아네 식료품 창고가 텅 비었어요.

sentences.text: Desde el jardín, Diego ve la cúpula de la iglesia del pueblo por encima de los tejados.
sentences.en: From the garden, Diego can see the dome of the village church above the rooftops.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 정원에서 지붕들 너머로 마을 성당의 돔을 볼 수 있어요.

sentences.text: Los amigos de Sofía se hicieron una foto delante de la cúpula de la catedral, como en el viaje de fin de curso.
sentences.en: Sofía's friends took a photo in front of the cathedral dome, just like on their end-of-year school trip.
sentences.ko: 소피아의 친구들은 수학여행 때처럼 대성당 돔 앞에서 사진을 찍었어요.

sentences.text: Los obreros de Diego almuerzan un estofado que trae la dueña del bar de la esquina.
sentences.en: Diego's workers have a stew for lunch that the owner of the corner bar brings over.
sentences.ko: 디에고네 인부들은 모퉁이 바 주인이 가져다주는 스튜로 점심을 먹어요.

sentences.text: La madre de Sofía preparó un estofado de ternera para recibir a todos.
sentences.en: Sofía's mother made a beef stew to welcome everyone.
sentences.ko: 소피아의 어머니는 모두를 맞이하려고 소고기 스튜를 끓였어요.

sentences.text: Diego encontró en un cajón unas cartas de su bisabuela sobre la maternidad y la vida en el campo.
sentences.en: Diego found some letters in a drawer from his great-grandmother about motherhood and life in the countryside.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 서랍에서 증조할머니가 모성과 시골 생활에 대해 쓴 편지들을 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Marta habló de la maternidad y de lo mucho que le ha cambiado la vida desde que nació su hija.
sentences.en: Marta talked about motherhood and how much her life has changed since her daughter was born.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 엄마가 된다는 것과 딸이 태어난 뒤 삶이 얼마나 바뀌었는지 이야기했어요.

sentences.text: La única sartén que quedaba en la casa estaba tan oxidada que Diego la tiró.
sentences.en: The only frying pan left in the house was so rusty that Diego threw it out.
sentences.ko: 집에 남은 프라이팬 하나가 너무 녹슬어서 디에고는 버렸어요.

sentences.text: Sofía sirvió las tortillas directamente en la sartén, en medio de la mesa.
sentences.en: Sofía served the omelettes straight in the frying pan, in the middle of the table.
sentences.ko: 소피아는 토르티야를 프라이팬째 식탁 가운데에 내놓았어요.

sentences.text: Antes de empezar a trabajar, Diego desayuna un tazón de avena con plátano.
sentences.en: Before starting work, Diego has a bowl of oats with banana for breakfast.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 일을 시작하기 전에 바나나를 넣은 귀리 한 그릇으로 아침을 먹어요.

sentences.text: Andrés, que ahora es muy deportista, solo pidió unas galletas de avena con el café.
sentences.en: Andrés, who is very sporty now, only ordered some oat biscuits with his coffee.
sentences.ko: 요즘 운동에 빠진 안드레스는 커피에 귀리 쿠키만 시켰어요.

sentences.text: El fontanero llegó sonriente porque Diego le había dicho que la avería era pequeña.
sentences.en: The plumber arrived smiling because Diego had told him the fault was small.
sentences.ko: 디에고가 고장이 작다고 해서 배관공은 웃으며 왔어요.

sentences.text: En la foto de grupo, Sofía sale sonriente entre sus dos mejores amigas.
sentences.en: In the group photo, Sofía is smiling between her two best friends.
sentences.ko: 단체 사진에서 소피아는 가장 친한 친구 둘 사이에서 웃고 있어요.

sentences.text: En el salón de Diego cuelga un cuadro de un velero, y en la popa se lee el nombre de la casa.
sentences.en: In Diego's living room hangs a painting of a sailboat, and on the stern you can read the name of the house.
sentences.ko: 디에고네 거실에는 범선 그림이 걸려 있는데, 배 뒷부분에 집 이름이 적혀 있어요.

sentences.text: Pablo contó que había pasado el verano trabajando en la popa de un barco de pesca.
sentences.en: Pablo said he had spent the summer working at the stern of a fishing boat.
sentences.ko: 파블로는 여름 내내 고깃배 뒤쪽에서 일했다고 했어요.

sentences.text: Diego no quiere defraudar a su abuelo, que construyó la casa con sus propias manos.
sentences.en: Diego doesn't want to let down his grandfather, who built the house with his own hands.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 손수 이 집을 지은 할아버지를 실망시키고 싶지 않아요.

sentences.text: Sofía no quería defraudar a nadie, así que reservó la mesa con un mes de antelación.
sentences.en: Sofía didn't want to disappoint anyone, so she booked the table a month in advance.
sentences.ko: 소피아는 아무도 실망시키고 싶지 않아서 한 달 전에 자리를 예약했어요.

sentences.text: El arquitecto le dijo a Diego que sería prematuro tirar el muro antes de revisar la estructura.
sentences.en: The architect told Diego it would be premature to knock down the wall before checking the structure.
sentences.ko: 건축가는 디에고에게 구조를 점검하기 전에 벽을 허무는 건 성급하다고 말했어요.

sentences.text: El hijo de Marta fue prematuro, pero ahora es el niño más alto de su clase.
sentences.en: Marta's son was premature, but now he's the tallest boy in his class.
sentences.ko: 마르타의 아들은 일찍 태어났지만 지금은 반에서 키가 제일 커요.

sentences.text: Para celebrar la compra de la casa, Diego abrió una lata de caviar que le habían regalado.
sentences.en: To celebrate buying the house, Diego opened a tin of caviar he had been given.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 집을 산 걸 축하하려고 선물 받은 캐비아 통조림을 땄어요.

sentences.text: Para la ocasión, Javier trajo una lata de caviar que nadie se atrevió a probar.
sentences.en: For the occasion, Javier brought a tin of caviar that nobody dared to try.
sentences.ko: 하비에르는 이날을 위해 캐비아 통조림을 가져왔지만 아무도 먹어 볼 엄두를 못 냈어요.

sentences.text: Las ventanas nuevas tienen marcos de aluminio, pero Diego quería conservar las de madera.
sentences.en: The new windows have aluminium frames, but Diego wanted to keep the wooden ones.
sentences.ko: 새 창문은 알루미늄 틀이지만 디에고는 나무 창문을 그대로 두고 싶었어요.

sentences.text: Sofía envolvió las patatas en papel de aluminio y las metió en la barbacoa.
sentences.en: Sofía wrapped the potatoes in aluminium foil and put them on the barbecue.
sentences.ko: 소피아는 감자를 은박지에 싸서 바비큐 그릴에 넣었어요.

sentences.text: Diego puso un candado en el cobertizo para que nadie se llevara las herramientas.
sentences.en: Diego put a padlock on the shed so no one would take the tools.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 아무도 연장을 가져가지 못하게 창고에 자물쇠를 달았어요.

sentences.text: En el puente del río, Sofía y sus amigos encontraron el candado que habían puesto hace años.
sentences.en: On the bridge over the river, Sofía and her friends found the padlock they had put there years ago.
sentences.ko: 소피아와 친구들은 강 다리에서 몇 년 전에 걸어 둔 자물쇠를 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Cuando empezó a llover, Diego cubrió los sacos de cemento con una lona.
sentences.en: When it started to rain, Diego covered the cement bags with a tarp.
sentences.ko: 비가 오기 시작하자 디에고는 시멘트 포대를 방수포로 덮었어요.

sentences.text: Como amenazaba lluvia, montaron una lona sobre la mesa del patio de Sofía.
sentences.en: As rain was threatening, they put up a tarp over the table in Sofía's patio.
sentences.ko: 비가 올 것 같아서 소피아네 마당 식탁 위에 천막을 쳤어요.

sentences.text: Al quitar el papel pintado, Diego se pinchó con un alfiler olvidado en la pared.
sentences.en: While stripping the wallpaper, Diego pricked himself on a pin left in the wall.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 벽지를 뜯다가 벽에 남아 있던 핀에 찔렸어요.

sentences.text: Sofía llevaba en la chaqueta el alfiler con el escudo del colegio.
sentences.en: Sofía wore the pin with the school crest on her jacket.
sentences.ko: 소피아는 재킷에 학교 문장이 새겨진 핀을 달고 왔어요.

sentences.text: Pegado a la nevera vieja, Diego encontró un imán con forma de sol.
sentences.en: Stuck to the old fridge, Diego found a sun-shaped magnet.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 낡은 냉장고에 붙은 해 모양 자석을 발견했어요.

sentences.text: Cada amigo de Sofía se llevó un imán con la foto del grupo para la nevera.
sentences.en: Each of Sofía's friends took home a fridge magnet with the group photo.
sentences.ko: 소피아의 친구들은 저마다 단체 사진이 들어간 냉장고 자석을 가져갔어요.

sentences.text: Antes de podar el seto, Diego tuvo que afilar las tijeras.
sentences.en: Before trimming the hedge, Diego had to sharpen the shears.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 울타리를 다듬기 전에 가위를 갈아야 했어요.

sentences.text: Antes de cortar el jamón, el padre de Sofía tuvo que afilar el cuchillo.
sentences.en: Before carving the ham, Sofía's father had to sharpen the knife.
sentences.ko: 소피아의 아버지는 하몽을 썰기 전에 칼을 갈아야 했어요.

sentences.text: El ayuntamiento obliga a Diego a pintar la fachada del mismo color que tenía.
sentences.en: The town hall requires Diego to paint the façade the same colour it was.
sentences.ko: 시청은 디에고에게 건물 외벽을 원래 색으로 칠하라고 해요.

sentences.text: Cuando Sofía vio la fachada de su antiguo colegio, se le escapó una lágrima.
sentences.en: When Sofía saw the front of her old school, a tear slipped out.
sentences.ko: 옛 학교 건물 정면을 보자 소피아는 눈물이 핑 돌았어요.

sentences.text: Cada vez que Diego enchufa la radial, salta un fusible.
sentences.en: Every time Diego plugs in the angle grinder, a fuse blows.
sentences.ko: 디에고가 그라인더를 꽂을 때마다 퓨즈가 나가요.

sentences.text: A mitad de la fiesta saltó un fusible y la casa de Sofía se quedó a oscuras.
sentences.en: Halfway through the party a fuse blew and Sofía's house was left in the dark.
sentences.ko: 파티 도중에 퓨즈가 나가서 소피아네 집이 깜깜해졌어요.

sentences.text: En invierno, la única estufa de la casa apenas calienta la cocina de Diego.
sentences.en: In winter, the only heater in the house barely warms Diego's kitchen.
sentences.ko: 겨울이면 집에 하나뿐인 난로로는 디에고네 부엌도 겨우 데워져요.

sentences.en: It was cold on the terrace, so Sofía's friends lit a gas heater next to the table.

sentences.text: Diego pasó el dedo por el filo del cincel para comprobar si cortaba.
sentences.en: Diego ran his finger along the edge of the chisel to check whether it was sharp.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 끌이 잘 드는지 보려고 날에 손가락을 대 봤어요.

sentences.text: Sofía cortó la tarta con el filo de un cuchillo de pan.
sentences.en: Sofía cut the cake with the edge of a bread knife.
sentences.ko: 소피아는 빵칼 날로 케이크를 잘랐어요.

sentences.text: El umbral de la puerta principal está tan gastado que Diego lo va a cambiar.
sentences.en: The threshold of the front door is so worn that Diego is going to replace it.
sentences.ko: 현관 문지방이 너무 닳아서 디에고는 새로 바꿀 거예요.

sentences.text: Al cruzar el umbral, Sofía reconoció enseguida la voz de su amiga Elena.
sentences.en: As she crossed the threshold, Sofía immediately recognised her friend Elena's voice.
sentences.ko: 문지방을 넘자마자 소피아는 친구 엘레나의 목소리를 알아들었어요.

sentences.text: Diego arrancó el fregadero de piedra y lo convirtió en una jardinera.
sentences.en: Diego pulled out the stone sink and turned it into a planter.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 돌 개수대를 뜯어내서 화분으로 만들었어요.

sentences.text: Después de cenar, Sofía y Elena lavaron los platos en el fregadero, como en los viejos tiempos.
sentences.en: After dinner, Sofía and Elena washed the dishes in the sink, like in the old days.
sentences.ko: 저녁을 먹고 소피아와 엘레나는 옛날처럼 개수대에서 설거지를 했어요.

sentences.text: Una grieta enorme le hizo sospechar a Diego que había un problema en el cimiento de la casa.
sentences.en: A huge crack made Diego suspect there was a problem with the house's foundation.
sentences.ko: 큰 금을 보고 디에고는 집 기초에 문제가 있다고 의심했어요.

sentences.text: Sofía dijo que aquella amistad era el cimiento de todo lo bueno de su juventud.
sentences.en: Sofía said that friendship was the foundation of everything good in her youth.
sentences.ko: 소피아는 그 우정이 자기 젊은 시절의 좋은 것들의 바탕이었다고 말했어요.

sentences.text: Los vecinos llaman a la casa de Diego «la casa durmiente» porque estuvo cerrada veinte años.
sentences.en: The neighbours call Diego's house "the sleeping house" because it was shut for twenty years.
sentences.ko: 이웃들은 디에고네 집이 이십 년 동안 닫혀 있어서 '잠자는 집'이라고 불러요.

sentences.text: Para la fiesta, Sofía recuperó el disfraz de bella durmiente que llevó en el colegio.
sentences.en: For the party, Sofía dug out the sleeping beauty costume she wore at school.
sentences.ko: 소피아는 파티를 위해 학교 때 입었던 잠자는 숲속의 공주 옷을 꺼냈어요.

sentences.text: El desagüe del patio estaba lleno de hojas y Diego tuvo que limpiarlo a mano.
sentences.en: The patio drain was full of leaves and Diego had to clean it by hand.
sentences.ko: 마당 배수구가 낙엽으로 꽉 차서 디에고는 손으로 치워야 했어요.

sentences.text: Alguien tiró restos de arroz por el desagüe y Sofía tuvo que desatascarlo.
sentences.en: Someone threw leftover rice down the drain and Sofía had to unblock it.
sentences.ko: 누가 남은 밥을 배수구에 버려서 소피아가 뚫어야 했어요.

sentences.text: La hermana de Diego le ayudará a decorar el dormitorio cuando acabe la obra.
sentences.en: Diego's sister will help him decorate the bedroom when the work is finished.
sentences.ko: 공사가 끝나면 디에고의 누나가 침실 꾸미는 걸 도와줄 거예요.

sentences.text: Sofía pidió a sus sobrinos que la ayudaran a decorar el salón con globos.
sentences.en: Sofía asked her nephews to help her decorate the living room with balloons.
sentences.ko: 소피아는 조카들에게 거실을 풍선으로 꾸미는 걸 도와 달라고 했어요.

sentences.text: Diego llevó al punto limpio cada trasto que había en el garaje.
sentences.en: Diego took every bit of junk in the garage to the recycling centre.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 차고에 있던 잡동사니를 하나하나 재활용 센터로 가져갔어요.

sentences.text: Javier aún conserva cada trasto del piso de estudiantes que compartió con Sofía.
sentences.en: Javier still keeps every bit of junk from the student flat he shared with Sofía.
sentences.ko: 하비에르는 소피아와 함께 살던 학생 시절 집의 잡동사니를 아직도 다 갖고 있어요.

sentences.text: La persiana del dormitorio no baja, y Diego tiene que cambiar la cinta.
sentences.en: The bedroom blind won't come down, and Diego has to replace the strap.
sentences.ko: 침실 블라인드가 안 내려가서 디에고는 끈을 갈아야 해요.

sentences.text: Sofía bajó la persiana porque el sol daba de lleno en la mesa.
sentences.en: Sofía lowered the blind because the sun was shining right on the table.
sentences.ko: 햇빛이 식탁에 정면으로 들어서 소피아는 블라인드를 내렸어요.

sentences.text: Diego encontró un cojín bordado que su abuela había hecho a mano.
sentences.en: Diego found an embroidered cushion his grandmother had made by hand.
sentences.ko: 디에고는 할머니가 손수 수놓은 쿠션을 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Elena se quedó dormida en el sofá de Sofía abrazada a un cojín.
sentences.en: Elena fell asleep on Sofía's sofa hugging a cushion.
sentences.ko: 엘레나는 소피아네 소파에서 쿠션을 끌어안고 잠들었어요.

sentences.text: Una viga del techo estaba podrida, así que Diego llamó a un carpintero.
sentences.en: One of the ceiling beams was rotten, so Diego called a carpenter.
sentences.ko: 천장 들보 하나가 썩어서 디에고는 목수를 불렀어요.

sentences.text: La casa rural que alquiló Sofía tiene vigas de madera en el techo.
sentences.en: The country house Sofía rented has wooden beams on the ceiling.
sentences.ko: 소피아가 빌린 시골집은 천장에 나무 들보가 있어요.

sentences.text: La inmobiliaria le dijo a Diego que la casa valdría el doble después de la reforma.
sentences.en: The estate agency told Diego the house would be worth twice as much after the renovation.
sentences.ko: 부동산 중개소는 디에고에게 수리하고 나면 집값이 두 배가 될 거라고 했어요.

sentences.text: Diana, que trabaja en una inmobiliaria, ayudó a Sofía a encontrar la casa rural.
sentences.en: Diana, who works at an estate agency, helped Sofía find the country house.
sentences.ko: 부동산 중개소에서 일하는 디아나가 소피아가 시골집을 찾는 걸 도와줬어요.

sentences.text: Las tuberías de la casa de Diego no estaban conectadas a la cloaca municipal.
sentences.en: The pipes in Diego's house weren't connected to the town sewer.
sentences.ko: 디에고네 집 배관은 시 하수도에 연결돼 있지 않았어요.

sentences.text: Los amigos de Sofía se rieron al recordar el día en que una pelota cayó a la cloaca del barrio.
sentences.en: Sofía's friends laughed remembering the day a ball fell into the neighbourhood sewer.
sentences.ko: 소피아의 친구들은 공이 동네 하수구에 빠졌던 날을 떠올리며 웃었어요.
